summary: WaveLoop Kit, a fork of the Felucca multi-engine synth firmware that adds standalone control from an Arturia MiniLab 3 over DIN MIDI, plus a song setlist and autosave for live sets.
features: Felucca base: 13 engines, four tracks sharing 8 voices, 64-step sequencer
MiniLab 3 map: track faders, per-channel knobs, held effect pads, DJ filter
12 songs in a reorderable setlist; autosaves after five seconds of silence
Up to 32 patches per synth engine; extra 808, CR-78-style and FM kits
Arpeggiator replaced by SHAYPE, a drawn pattern played over held chords
Needs this fork's release package; the upstream installer gives plain Felucca
